description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application. It sets up the main screen with a horizontal carousel of video items, including layout initialization, sample data population, and focus management for TV navigation.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the Android TV home screen that displays a horizontally scrolling carousel of videos with focus management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the RecyclerView with sample video data, and manages focus behavior for TV navigation.
